Requested background, layout and glow changes are excluded. Instruction: The edit adds a centered painting, blue gradient, decorative clouds, bright frame halo and serif heading. A complete result would also have surrounding flying cranes, the exact specified title and readable handwritten event details at bottom left; external cranes are absent, the heading is gibberish and the bottom writing conveys no event information. Partial compliance. Quality: Structure and poster layout are coherent, but both prominent heading and footer contain malformed nonsensical text, and a watermark remains within the art; multiple distracting textual artifacts warrant 2. Knowledge is not applicable.
